PROJECT 2INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT / GAMEPLAY

First-Person
Shooter.

From skeletal rigs to the moment a bullet hits. An independently developed FPS prototype connecting animation, physical projectiles and player feedback.

BlenderUnreal Engine 5Solo project
Watch on Bilibili

INDEPENDENT DEVELOPER

Rigging & animation

Created firearm rigs and action animations in Blender, edited animation curves, and connected them to UE5 animation state machines. Implemented magazine inspection and a live ammunition display.

Projectiles & target destruction

Implemented physical projectiles with bullet drop and ricochet simulation. In the test scene, projectile impacts trigger fracture effects on target cubes.

Location-based hit feedback

Hit detection triggers different physics-driven responses by impact location: collapse after a leg hit, or a backward stagger or fall after a torso hit.
